title: WORK-LAB Policy Projection Contract
description: Uniform renderer interface: GlobalAgentPolicy + software extension -> SoftwarePolicyRenderer -> NativeProjection + ProjectionLossReport. Every adapter MUST emit a loss report; the five-state capability vocabulary is mandatory. A single boolean 'supported' is not enough.

renderer.description: Module path or class that performs the projection.

extensions_path.description: Software-specific extension file (kept OUT of the neutral global core).

loss_report.description: Inline ProjectionLossReport if the projection has been run.
